BASELINE.rule: shipped M3 preset: ratio 1.2, boxes, ADX 20, pivot/purple stop, trail 360/900/180, hold through opposite

cool_1m_all.rule: no all entry for 1 min after a loss

cool_1m_same.rule: no same entry for 1 min after a loss

cool_1m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 1 min after a loss

cool_3m_all.rule: no all entry for 3 min after a loss

cool_3m_same.rule: no same entry for 3 min after a loss

cool_3m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 3 min after a loss

cool_5m_all.rule: no all entry for 5 min after a loss

cool_5m_same.rule: no same entry for 5 min after a loss

cool_5m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 5 min after a loss

cool_10m_all.rule: no all entry for 10 min after a loss

cool_10m_same.rule: no same entry for 10 min after a loss

cool_10m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 10 min after a loss

cool_15m_all.rule: no all entry for 15 min after a loss

cool_15m_same.rule: no same entry for 15 min after a loss

cool_15m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 15 min after a loss

cool_20m_all.rule: no all entry for 20 min after a loss

cool_20m_same.rule: no same entry for 20 min after a loss

cool_20m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 20 min after a loss

cool_30m_all.rule: no all entry for 30 min after a loss

cool_30m_same.rule: no same entry for 30 min after a loss

cool_30m_opposite.rule: no opposite entry for 30 min after a loss

cool_1bars.rule: no entry for 1 closed M3 bars after a loss

cool_2bars.rule: no entry for 2 closed M3 bars after a loss

cool_3bars.rule: no entry for 3 closed M3 bars after a loss

cool_5bars.rule: no entry for 5 closed M3 bars after a loss

cool_10bars.rule: no entry for 10 closed M3 bars after a loss

opp_signal_age>=3.rule: previous opposite signal at least 3 bars old (signal reset)

opp_signal_age>=5.rule: previous opposite signal at least 5 bars old (signal reset)

opp_signal_age>=10.rule: previous opposite signal at least 10 bars old (signal reset)

opp_signal_age>=20.rule: previous opposite signal at least 20 bars old (signal reset)

flips_10<=1.rule: at most 1 other flips in the last 10 bars

flips_10<=2.rule: at most 2 other flips in the last 10 bars

flips_10<=3.rule: at most 3 other flips in the last 10 bars

flips_20<=2.rule: at most 2 other flips in the last 20 bars

flips_20<=3.rule: at most 3 other flips in the last 20 bars

flips_20<=4.rule: at most 4 other flips in the last 20 bars

flips_30<=4.rule: at most 4 other flips in the last 30 bars

flips_30<=6.rule: at most 6 other flips in the last 30 bars

opp_candles5<=2.rule: at most 2 of the last 5 candles against the signal

opp_candles5<=3.rule: at most 3 of the last 5 candles against the signal

dist_prev_sig>=1.0.rule: price >= 1.0 x ATR from the previous signal

dist_prev_sig>=2.0.rule: price >= 2.0 x ATR from the previous signal

stop_atr1.0.rule: SL = 1.0 x ATR from the signal close

stop_atr1.5.rule: SL = 1.5 x ATR from the signal close

stop_atr2.0.rule: SL = 2.0 x ATR from the signal close

stop_atr3.0.rule: SL = 3.0 x ATR from the signal close

stop_hybrid0.75_cap3.0.rule: SL = max(structure, 0.75 x ATR), skip if > 3.0 x ATR

stop_hybrid1.0_cap3.0.rule: SL = max(structure, 1.0 x ATR), skip if > 3.0 x ATR

stop_hybrid1.0_cap4.0.rule: SL = max(structure, 1.0 x ATR), skip if > 4.0 x ATR

stop_hybrid1.5_cap4.0.rule: SL = max(structure, 1.5 x ATR), skip if > 4.0 x ATR

stop_pivot_cap2.0.rule: shipped stop, skip if > 2.0 x ATR

stop_pivot_cap3.0.rule: shipped stop, skip if > 3.0 x ATR

stop_pivot_cap4.0.rule: shipped stop, skip if > 4.0 x ATR

stop_purple.rule: SL = purple line from the first tick

rev_reverse.rule: close AND reverse on the opposite signal (your tester setting)

rev_modelA_close.rule: Model A: close on the opposite signal, never reverse

rev_modelB_confirm1.rule: Model B: close only if the opposite direction persists 1 bars

rev_modelB_confirm2.rule: Model B: close only if the opposite direction persists 2 bars

rev_modelB_confirm3.rule: Model B: close only if the opposite direction persists 3 bars

rev_modelD_adx25.rule: Model D: close only if the opposite signal's ADX > 25

rev_modelD_adx30.rule: Model D: close only if the opposite signal's ADX > 30

lock_1.0R_keep0.25R.rule: at +1.0R lock +0.25R and trail 1:1 with a 0.75R gap

lock_1.5R_keep0.5R.rule: at +1.5R lock +0.5R and trail 1:1 with a 1.0R gap

lock_2.0R_keep0.5R.rule: at +2.0R lock +0.5R and trail 1:1 with a 1.5R gap
